{
"name":"response",
"type":"object",
"meetingId":"129",
"tickets":[
{
"title":"Request estate document package",
"text":"Subject: Estate planning document request\n\nHello Nolan Wrenpuddle,\n\nTo help keep the financial plan and account records aligned with the current estate plan, please send copies of any available documents listed below:\n\n- Will\n- Revocable trust or other trust agreements\n- Trust amendments or restatements\n- Durable power of attorney\n- Health care directive or medical power of attorney\n- Beneficiary designation confirmations\n- Letters of instruction or executor/trustee contact details\n- Any recent attorney summary letter\n\nIf another professional should provide these directly, please share the professional’s name, firm, email, and phone number: [________________].\n\nPreferred secure delivery method: [secure portal / encrypted email / mail / other: ________]\nDocuments already on file: [________________]\nDocuments still needed: [________________]\n\nThank you,\n[advisor/team name]\n\nObtain the current estate documents, including any updated trust amendments, durable power of attorney, health care directive, and attorney summary letter, to ensure the advisory file is complete.",
"priority":"medium",
"dueDate":"2026-02-19",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"The agreed follow-up is to obtain the current estate document package by 2026-02-19.",
"templateId":"f893c20e-c44a-568a-9217-439053a4b55d"
},
{
"title":"Review IRA beneficiary inconsistency",
"text":"Review the IRA beneficiary designations for Nolan Wrenpuddle's traditional and Roth IRAs at the custodian, noting that the Roth IRA still lists the 2014 revocable trust as sole beneficiary while the traditional IRA lists his children, and determine the appropriate updates to align both accounts with his intent for direct child inheritance.",
"priority":null,
"dueDate":"2026-02-26",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[],
"evidence":"Further follow-up is needed by 2026-02-26 on the IRA beneficiary inconsistency, because Nolan expected both retirement accounts to pass directly to his children unless there was a specific reason to keep the trust on one account.",
"templateId":null
},
{
"title":"Administer trust account setup and maintenance",
"text":"Coordinate trust account administration from authority verification through ongoing recordkeeping. Confirm trustee powers, account registration requirements, cash needs, investment constraints, tax reporting responsibilities, and documentation standards before assets are moved or invested.\n\nObtain evidence of the successor trustee sequence and authority for Nolan Wrenpuddle's revocable trust, confirming whether Priya Nettlewhisk has signed acceptance and whether any additional trustee changes are required.",
"priority":"high",
"dueDate":"2026-03-05",
"assigneeId":null,
"subTasks":[
{
"title":"Verify trustee authority and trust instructions",
"text":"Collect the signed trust agreement, relevant amendments, trustee acceptance or certification, and any custodian-specific trustee forms. Identify distribution standards, successor trustee provisions, tax identification needs, and any limits on investment discretion.",
"priority":"high",
"assigneeId":"c4974bf8-45b1-514a-913d-ed0a029805ab"
},
{
"title":"Prepare account opening and asset transfer package",
"text":"Assemble trust account application materials, transfer forms, cost basis records if available, and a checklist of assets expected to move into the trust account. Confirm titling language before submission.",
"priority":"medium",
"assigneeId":null
},
{
"title":"Establish administration calendar and records folder",
"text":"Create a reusable recordkeeping structure for statements, receipts, disbursements, tax documents, beneficiary notices, and trustee decisions. Add periodic reminders for cash review, tax reporting, and required beneficiary communications.",
"priority":"medium",
"assigneeId":null
}
],
"evidence":"Further follow-up is also needed by 2026-03-05 on the successor trustee sequence and authority evidence, because Carla remains ahead of Priya and Nolan is unsure whether Priya signed any acceptance or whether another child should be added later; this affects the estate review and possible future trust account administration steps.",
"templateId":"02c946e9-3747-56e1-b11c-a5fb332080fd"
}
]
}
